metadata.label: positive
metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: Photorealistic indoor scene of a ceramic teacup sitting on a wooden windowsill covered in fresh white snow. The snow directly beneath and immediately surrounding the cup has completely melted into a clear, shallow puddle, while the untouched snow a few inches away remains pristine and fluffy. Soft daylight, high detail, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: A hot cup naturally conducts heat to the snow beneath it, melting a localized puddle while leaving distant snow intact.
